§ Smoker Status & Forest Cover Type Classification | Python | Github Link December 2025
Developed supervised machine learning models for multi-class forest cover classification and binary smoker prediction. •
Performed extensive data preprocessing, feature engineering, and normalization to improve model training stability. •
Implemented and compared SVM, MLP, K-Means, Gaussian models, and Logistic Regression to evaluate •
performance. and applied cross-validation and hyperparameter tuning to improve performance.
Achieved 88.6% accuracy in forest cover classification and 75% accuracy in smoker prediction. •
§ ERP Academic Portal | Spring Boot, React, OAuth2, JWT | Github Link November 2025
Developed an academic portal using Spring Boot backend and React frontend to automate academic work. •
Implemented secure authentication using OAuth2 for Google

Built a Role-based access control system supporting Admin and User functionalities. •
Developed RESTful APIs for academic management, including modules for departments, employees, and admin user. •
Configured CORS policies and integrated Swagger UI for secure communication and automated API documentation. •
§ Obesity Level Classification | Python, XGBoost, Optuna | Github Link October 2025
Developed a multi-class obesity prediction model using lifestyle attributes with preprocessing and feature •
engineering.
Performed exploratory data analysis to identify factors affecting obesity classification. •
Implemented Decision Tree, AdaBoost, and Random Forest using GridSearchCV and built an XGBoost •
classifier with Optuna-based hyperparameter tuning and cross-validation.
Achieved 91.23% accuracy, outperforming baseline machine learning models in classification performance.

§ Bank Management System | C, Linux, TCP Sockets | Github Link September 2025
Developed a multi-user banking system using TCP socket-based client-server architecture on Linux. •
Implemented role-based access control supporting Admin, Manager, Employee, and Customer banking operations. •
Ensured concurrency safety using fcntl-based file locking mechanisms. •
Designed persistent storage using binary file handling with auto-incremented account and transaction identifiers.
